items.title: Record rollout findings and publish Lattice install guidance
items.context: Capture M1 real-project rollout findings and update README/docs so the primary command is lattice, koala is legacy alias, and local global refresh steps are explicit.
items.userSees: 用户在 README/guide 中看到 `lattice check`、`lattice doctor`、`lattice session_brief`，并看到 `koala` 仅作为 legacy alias。

items.title: Make user-facing CLI help and hints prefer lattice
items.context: Update help banners, next-step hints, doctor/check/session output, and command examples so invoked or recommended commands say lattice by default while keeping koala compatibility.
items.userSees: 用户执行 `lattice story_create --help` 时主标题、示例和下一步优先显示 `lattice ...`，不再推荐 `koala ...`。

items.title: Add read-only lattice rollout_check command
items.context: Implement a cross-project rollout checker that scans selected roots or project lists for global CLI version, lattice/koala realpath, config doctor status, session/doctor/check status, managed asset drift, and transcript lifecycle readiness without modifying projects.
items.userSees: 用户执行 `lattice rollout_check --projects <paths> --json` 得到每个项目 PASS/WARN/FAIL 和 next action，不需要逐个手跑 doctor/check。

items.title: Verify rollout_check and lattice command semantics across real projects
items.context: Add focused smoke tests plus a real-project transcript covering Orchestrate, Koala/Koala, plasmid, minicell, OpenCli, and avalon behavior from M1.
items.userSees: 用户看到 TEST transcript 中列出真实项目巡检结果，并看到 rollout_check 能把外部项目状态解释成 warning 而非混乱失败。
